description: This file defines a SwiftUI View named CostUsageHistoryMenuView, which displays cost usage data in a chart format along with header and footer sections. It references data models and formatting utilities related to cost usage summaries.

classes.name: CostUsageHistoryMenuView
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that presents cost usage data including a header with today's costs, a chart of daily costs, and a footer indicating missing cost entries.

methods.name: header
methods.description: A computed property returning a view that displays today's total cost and overall total costs, using date parsing and formatting utilities.

methods.name: chart
methods.description: A computed property returning a chart view that visualizes daily cost data using bar marks, with customized axis labels.

methods.name: footer
methods.description: A computed property returning a footer view indicating if there are missing cost entries.

methods.name: CostUsageMenuDateParser.parse
methods.description: Parses a string date in 'yyyy-MM-dd' format into a Date object.

methods.name: CostUsageMenuDateParser.format
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a string with 'yyyy-MM-dd' format.
